scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Ultra Time Patrol Battles and Gallery of Time research
verification_policy: Separate official feature existence from player-reported progression and reward behavior. Do not infer exact thresholds, rewards, or unlock order from promotional descriptions or video titles.

sources.scope: Chapter 4 official content overview; confirms Ultra Time Patrol Battles and Gallery of Time
Official July 22, 2026 Future Saga recap and Chapter 4 preview
Official product listing; identifies Ultra Time Patrol Battles as a new high-difficulty quest and eight loading-screen illustrations
Community testing report describing round structure, randomized early-round opponents, carried progression rules, boosts, and reported reward behavior
Community discussion lead concerning whether the mode provides a reward and whether an artwork is associated with a no-stat-boost clear

official_feature_records.name: Ultra Time Patrol Battles
official_feature_records.official_description: Chapter 4 adds Ultra Time Patrol Battles as a new high-difficulty quest feature.

official_feature_records.name: Gallery of Time
official_feature_records.official_description: Chapter 4 adds a Gallery of Time feature associated with loading-screen illustrations and Time Patrol history content.

community_mechanics_leads.claim: A community testing report describes the mode as a three-round gauntlet, with three battles in each round.
community_mechanics_leads.evidence_limit: Not independently verified against an official mission specification.

community_mechanics_leads.claim: The same report states that the first and second rounds can vary in opponent selection while the final round follows a more consistent sequence.
community_mechanics_leads.evidence_limit: Exact randomization pool and final-round sequence remain unresolved.

community_mechanics_leads.claim: The report states that consumable items and Limit Burst availability do not carry over between rounds.
community_mechanics_leads.evidence_limit: Exact implementation and exceptions remain unresolved.

community_mechanics_leads.claim: The report describes a selectable boost system between battles/rounds and a rarer stronger boost selection.
community_mechanics_leads.evidence_limit: Exact boost catalogue, values, selection rules, and persistence are unresolved.

community_mechanics_leads.claim: Community reports associate completing the full mode without taking offered stat boosts with an artwork reward.
community_mechanics_leads.evidence_limit: The exact artwork, exact condition, and whether this is the sole reward remain unresolved; this is not promoted to a verified reward mapping.

research_leads.claim: Secondary coverage reports that completing new high-difficulty content can unlock loading-screen art.
research_leads.evidence_limit: This does not establish a complete one-to-one reward table, exact completion threshold, or exact sequence for all eight illustrations.

important_nonclaims: The official feature description is not used to invent a number of individual Ultra Time Patrol Battle missions.
No exact score, rank, clear-count, or completion-time threshold is inferred.
No exact boost value is inferred from community discussion.
No loading-screen illustration is assigned to a specific battle without direct evidence.
Community reports of an artwork for a no-stat-boost clear are not treated as proof of a canonical reward table.
No rewards, item IDs, or character unlocks are inferred from video titles or thumbnails.
research_targets: Identify every individual Ultra Time Patrol Battle encounter and its unlock requirement.
Record the exact nine-battle structure, enemy formations, stages, special rules, and final-round sequence if independently evidenced.
Document the selectable boost system, including every known boost and its exact effects, while preserving uncertain values as unresolved.
Determine whether items and Limit Burst are reset between every battle, every round, or other checkpoints and record exceptions.
Determine the complete reward table and exact no-stat-boost artwork condition.
Map the eight Chapter 4 loading-screen illustrations to exact acquisition/progression conditions.
Document what pre-Chapter-4 historical material the Gallery of Time exposes and how progression is structured.
Check whether the new Gallery has permanent account progression, repeatable rewards, or only collection/unlock tracking.
